notes.title: Friday Progress Report 433
notes.content: [p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/4c0a70586117e533aed868b238102adf8e4fdbc3.png"][/img][/p][p]The tutorial is now almost done, we just need to finish the last few stages and test/bugfix, it should be done by next Friday.[/p][p][/p][p]Again another short report.[/p]

notes.title: Friday Progress Report 432
notes.content: [p]The custom characters now have their own intro featuring Reiko, Sasha, Marie, Elly, Frederick and Adam.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/16b66f312b5b20ec7e3644fee68635e9239ab571.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The new tutorial is 50% done, the first parts featuring Sasha, Tiana, Yukari and Frederick are done, we are now working overtime to get this done by next friday.[/p]

notes.title: Friday Progress Report 431
notes.content: [p]The new tutorial is about 30% complete.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/677a23d1efb41c9f6107c5e9a7313668f132a521.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Almost every tutorial step is now linked to the characters, they will send you around the town doing tasks and the new tutorial screens will pop up between steps.[/p][p]We are also improving the talk scene a bit, with buttons to access the current NPC quest or their trader screen if they have one, as well as the chat story in case you skip something by accident.[/p][p]We will finish it before the end of the month.[/p]

notes.title: Friday Progress Report 430
notes.content: [p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/70c13295f699f08b84efd52a0c17f2001f5a3718.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The new tutorial scene is much larger and can display videos.[/p][p]This week we worked on the stuff behind the scenes, coding and filling xml files, so we have little to show today, we might have the first steps of the new tutorial next week if we finish squashing all the new bugs in time.[/p][p]Short report this week, sorry.[/p]

[b]Features:[/b]
Reworked the path helper
Added a UI option to scale up the fishing UI
Improved the talk scene with chat history

[b]Changes:[/b]
Reworked how the UI works so particles can draw over it
Improved the fishing UI visuals and feedback
Fish can no longer pull when stunned
Fixed collision issues with furniture

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
Fixed the now-cosmetic-cart giving water like a well
Fixed some textures being one-side and not drawing on the other side
Fixed a hidden feature that happens during midnight on specific days not working properly
Fixed the frilly shirt not drawing outlines
Fixed some pickaxe targeting issues

notes.title: Friday Progress Report 429
notes.content: [p]We are still testing, fixing bugs and doing little improvements[/p][p]There are a few improvements on feedback during fishing, some stuff not drawing correctly and many minor adjustments we actually forgot to put in the changelog...[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/c77bcbf060dd808dbb2e3dc564589405ca315c8e.png"][/img][/p][p]Since we want to replace the old UI with the new model and doing all at once would take too long we managed to merge both temporarily in a single model so we can replace parts little by little... but this caused a TON of issues, so we spent the whole week finding and squashing new bugs.[/p][p]We should have caught the last few bugs, so the patch should come out tonight, or tomorrow in the worst case.[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Friday Progress Report 428
notes.content: [p]The new tutorial interacts with the NPCs, so we are using the opportunity to improve the talk scene, we are adding more support for conditions changing texts, choices, text history and such.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/aa880efbe69191dc5bd4d128f2b70e0ea0c0e7a2.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We have prepared a small video clip for each tutorial stage and will add support for the game to display them next, so the tutorial pages are less text and more image.[/p][p][/p][p]Small report for this week, most of what we are working on is groundwork for bigger features, we also have a good amount of bugfixes ready, but we need to fix the talk scene modifications to not break anything on release.[/p][p][/p][p]Maybe bugfix patch next week.[/p]

notes.title: Friday Progress Report 427
notes.content: [p]Since the new tutorial is focused on the NPCs we improved the guide particles and made the NPCs silhouettes visible through the walls.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/17d686d488143d46c293598bdd5f43e6c2318af6.png"][/img][/p][p]75% of the tutorial videos are done, my brother is working on improvements on the talk scene, adding features like a chat log to go back and read what NPCs said before, choices so you will finally be able to say something, showing images, more conditionals for the talk events and other lesser features.[/p][p][/p][p]While working on this we also found a few more bugs, so we will probably release a new patch soon with several small fixes, but no actual real features because they are not done yet.[/p][p][/p][p]Its a short report this week, see you next Friday.[/p]

notes.title: Friday Progress Report 426
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/7078de5f4a2d74529641a2b5625dce8958821bd9.png"][/img][/p][p]We planned all the updates up to the end of early access, we won't be able to make it all the way to v1.0 because we still have way too many features to implement, so we will quit early access on v0.85.[/p][p][/p][p][b]What effect will this have on the players?[/b][/p][p]Nothing will change for you guys. We will keep developing after v0.85 as usual, there will be no price increases until at least after v1.0. Also there will be no paid DLC until all features we promised have been delivered. (we don't like the idea of paid DLC to begin with)[/p][p][/p][p][b]Why are you making this change?[/b][/p][p]We think being in early access for so long is hurting our visibility on Steam, also by v0.85 I would say the game will be worth its price and can be judged for its contents even if it is technically incomplete. Right now the game is selling so bad we only receive a paycheck from Steam every 2~3 months because the money is not hitting the minimum amount required to send a payment.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Will there be more polls?[/b][/p][p]Yes, v0.83 is divided in 4 main features, and the order we implement them will be up to community votes, same for the 2 main features of v0.85. Also after we leave early access there will be a very large list of features we will be putting up to vote.[/p][p][/p][p]If you guys have any questions on the planned features feel free to ask away.[/p]

notes.title: Friday Progress Report 425 - Tree Update done!
notes.content: [h2][b]The Tree Update is done![/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/1e85d3eab7a06d4ec2552cf64c05f83b3f51d0f4.png"][/img][/p][p]Most of the following was already live, this update from today has the last finishing touches, we have decided to release this update little by little instead of all at once. If you haven't played Edengrall in the last 2 months here the new stuff you can find ingame:[/p][p][/p][p]There are now 15 wild trees, plus two special trees.[/p][p][b]Non-fruit Trees:[/b] Birch, Lightwood and Darkoak[/p][p][b]Fruit Trees:[/b] Apple, Mango, Pear, Lime, Lemon, Orange, Peach, Olives, Avocado, Cherry, Fig and Almonds[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/6613589994385890622b687bf9439241f72bfdb3.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Bushes[/b]: There are 3 new types of bush that flower during spring, they do not have edible fruits, but their flowers are edible![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/56b9e1b49e0886d1b2812d2badd7a1df8babdf0b.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Wisdom Trees[/b] are an alchemically created variant of the Apples, they only grow inside Edengrall and cannot be cut down.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/3623ebe3a11132449cef34c47ee56351bbce2efb.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Ladrasil Trees[/b] are huge magical trees attuned to the seasons, their leaf colors and shapes change as the seasons pass, Fairies are attracted to these trees.[/p][p][/p][p][b][i]Tree Features:[/i][/b][/p][p][b]Dynamic Spawning[/b]: Each tree has a prefered enviroment, they slowly populate if there is space, if you are missing one specific fruit tree in your world cut some more common trees to open space and you will eventually see the missing trees grow.[/p][p][b]Slow growth[/b]: Trees grow slightly every day until they reach the adult stage, no sudden changes from today to tomorrow.[/p][p][b]Realistic collision[/b]: Trunks and branches have collision and you can climb on them.[/p][p][b]Leaf colors[/b]: Each tree has a different coloration for each season, the change is gradual, with slightly differences each day.[/p][p][b]Leaf loss on winter[/b]: Most trees slowly lose their leaves during the peak of winter and regain them by spring.[/p][p][b]Flowering and Fruiting[/b]: Each Fruit tree has their own fruiting season and the presence of flowers is a good indicator you are a few weeks from some tasty fruit.[/p][p][b]Mushrooms and Vines[/b]: Parasite flora grows on tree trunks, most of them are edible.[/p][p][b]Critters[/b]: Many critters live on trees, keep an eye out for bugs and lizards on trunks and branches as well as beehives.[/p][p][b]Planting[/b]: Adult trees drop saplings that you can plant yourself, trees planted by the player will never die from old age. There is no limit to the amount of trees you can plant.[/p][p][b]Tree cutting[/b]: All trees other than Wisdom Trees and Ladrasils can be cut down, most fruit trees give soft wood, if you want hard wood aim for Darkoak. Make sure to dig out the stumps or they will block the growth of new trees.[/p][p][b]Lumberaxe[/b]: No more placeholder gathering, want wood? Chop down a tree! The charge attack can be used to cut several trees in an circular area.[/p][p][/p][p]There are also other smaller features that we have added while working on this update:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Gems[/b]: Mining and Scavenging can now give you gemstones, right now they can be sold to Catarina for extra money, but one day we will add more uses to them.[/p][p][b]Better Tool Feedback[/b]: Better particles, sounds and a little bar that fills up when watering tiles.[/p][p][b]Tokay Gecko[/b]: A new critter that can only be found on tree trunks (during night)[/p][p][b]Spooky Bamboo Forest[/b]: The biome is now permanently covered in mist[/p][p][/p][p]What is next? We are now reviewing the roadmap, there will be a big update on our plans next week, we are changing a lot and we might even leave Early Access before the planned date.[/p]

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
Fixed a few visual glitches with some trees
Fixed an occlusion glitch in some buildings
Fixed an error at startup

[b]Features:[/b]
Birch Sap is now edible
Added mana crystals and fragments, right now they are just items for selling, but later on they will have uses
Mining nodes and some beached creates can now drop gems that you can sell for extra income (drop chances increase with your skills)
Added a progress bar to watering tiles and plant pots
The Sickle charge attack now harvests everything that can be harvested on trees
Hitting a tree with the axe or sickle will scare away critters

[b]Changes:[/b]
Crystal Scorpions, Snails and Trouts can be butchered to get mana crystals
Added mana crystals and fragments to bamboo forest treasure drop tables
Adjusted when Miralarium flowers can be harvested to match better the bush graphics
Added new particles to most tools
Dried food now caps at 15% water content
Syrup recipe has been overhauled
Lowered the distance for tool interactions in the horizontal axis, tool range is still high vertically to reach mining nodes in cave ceilings
Generic tree sap is being removed
Amber is now measured in units instead of weight
Buffed nutritional value of honey and rice
Lowered amount of mineral salt nodes

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
Fixed a bug in the dry food algorithm
Critters on trees now only correctly spawn in the correct times of day
The daily report now show recipes with no score as N/A instead of -100

notes.title: Friday Progress Report 424
notes.content: [p][/p][p]The sickle charge attack will now harvest all available harvestables in a tree if you hit the tree trunk with the slash, so you can get all fruit from a tree without having to hunt down hidden fruit within the leaves.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/58eaf5e1fea234ae4e92913e8caf5f1892a48b0c.png"][/img][/p][p]The sickle, lumberaxe, pickaxe, and hoe how have new particle effects and sounds to improve the tool use feedback[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/429c5e7d34a4e3617dba9826fe3241eec2293486.png"][/img][/p][p]We are reviewing a few recipes, the one getting a big overhaul is the Syrup recipe, it will no longer require sugar or starch, these are now optional and it can be made entirely out of juice or the new Birch sap, it will also use the dry food algorithm, reducing the water content of the ingredients to increase their taste and nutrient concentration. The dry food algorithm was a bit bugged too (was increasing tastes way more than it should), so we fixed it.[/p][p]Also we are removing the generic sap item from the trees, instead of a generic crafting mateiral saps will be edible when possible, right now only Birch will give edible sap, later on there will be Maple for sweet goodness and Pine for non-edible, but useful resin, if you already have taken down trees and collected sap in your save just sell it to NPCs, it won't have any uses and the item will be deleted from the game later.[/p][p]There will be more small fixes and changes, the update should drop in 2 or 3 days.[/p]

notes.title: 0.75.8.0 - Saplings
notes.content:
[b]Features:[/b]
Implemented tree saplings
Added Mango trees
Added Olive trees

[b]Changes:[/b]
Cutting trees may give other items besides just wood, like sap.
Bilboards now cast shadows

notes.title: Friday Progress Report 423
notes.content: [p]All the fruit trees are done, we are just finishing the saplings, there are two more bugs to fix, but once these are done we will release an update with the trees and the ability to plant them, maybe tonight or by Sunday.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/17fb6fbbeca70f525c24a5b6680eb5d2626acb5e.png"][/img][/p][p]There are two ways to acquire saplings, the first is to catch a tree growing, within the first 3 days of a tree growth you can use the shovel to collect it.[/p][p][/p][p]The second way to get saplings is to chop down an adult tree (this part is bugged right now, we are working on it).[/p][p][/p][p]The last two trees are here! I went with new leaf textures for these (it was a ton of work, but worth it)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/dd265560f787c95cc3295fc80ac8b65fe9dd13d9.png"][/img][/p][p]Olive trees fruit during late spring/early summer[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/380385feabde4e3c4694b1a7f8f4e8f65311c199.png"][/img][/p][p]Mango trees fruit during mid summer[/p][p][/p][p]After this update we only need to finish a few more features to be done with the Trees, the axe charge attack, and allowing the sickle charge to mass harvest tree fruits.[/p]

notes.title: Friday Progress Report 422
notes.content: [p]The work on tree planting is almost done, we should have all trees done and plantable by next friday![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/c46d68629cce1f0749c45774c56b31bf358362e4.png"][/img][/p][p]When planting a new tree you can see a ghost of the adult form and even rotate it[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/64a11e5c599245781414bdbf4b50a6d1ec1c266a.png"][/img][/p][p]You must plant the tree on soil, getting too close to the road or too close to any other plant will block the placement[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/102bb3cb65d78fea9ea2527389f1c8c0ca98ed2c.png"][/img][/p][p]There will be no limits to the number of trees you can plant, and player trees will never die from old age like the wild ones do, but beaware, trees are a resource hog and we don't have time right now to try further optimizations.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/387f11a4229257884d7f8014277f550c1c83a2b8.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Since last friday 5 new Trees have been finished, 2 are already ingame because we had an emergency patch done this week to fix a bug in character creation and since the trees were already done we added them in the patch, the other 3 will come out by next Friday when I finish the last 2 for a total of 5 new trees.[/p][p][/p][p]Avocado[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/3c0eee11e20d966b2be384cbfe58464826e091f6.png"][/img]One of the large fruit trees, they take a full year to mature, but to compensate they have the biggest harvests, each singular avocado fruit weights 0.5kg (1.1 pound). Fruits during late summer. This is one of the two trees that are already in.[/p][p][/p][p]Fig[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/f349fd198cb5c84e0b10dceb5ed39e2ae81a3fd5.png"][/img]Like the Avocado, this tree also takes a full year to mature, and to compensate it fruits twice a year! Giving fruits both in spring and autumn. This tree is also already ingame.[/p][p][/p][p]Pear[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/d2a66278dd9559dd580e4c8bc4efff73b2f187d2.png"][/img]I have taken some artistic freedoms with the Pear tree, not only it is pear shaped, but I also gave it vivid autumn colors, it contrasts with the fruits making them very easy to spot. It fruits during late Autumn.[/p][p][/p][p]Peach[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/6ccf3192dc997e9e86edfc1a690fe1bba7e24d1b.png"][/img]Peaches fruit during early Summer[/p][p][/p][p]Almond[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/49f8b7a57307b34e3c3a8c08be20593e83b8f34b.png"][/img]Almond trees fruit during early Autumn.[/p]

[b]Features:[/b]
Added Fig Trees
Added Avocado Trees

[b]Fixes:[/b]
Fixed a bug that could softlock in the character creation screen

[b]Changes: [/b]
Improved the pickaxe animations and usability

Fixes:
Fixed pickaxe special not changing targets if the target can't be destroyed

notes.title: Friday Progress Report 421
notes.content: [p]We finally got rid of the placeholders, now all trees are custom assets made by us! They grow, flower, fruit, change color, lose leaves in winter, can be cut down, can spawn mushrooms and even critters.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/56b9e1b49e0886d1b2812d2badd7a1df8babdf0b.png"][/img][/p][p]The trees inside the town are now Wisdom Trees, they fruit during late spring and give out Golden Apples (Wisdom Fruit), they only grow inside the town and cannot be cut down, they are property of Edengrall.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/272096e0de6d7113cdf3bbf49b375108af8f0cb3.png"][/img][/p][p]Lemon Trees will fruit during early/mid summer[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/07c1c88785b9bd9af1ddb4594fec9a77b5228b42.png"][/img][/p][p]Cherry Trees fruit during late spring/early summer[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/f21b3ce66c3b208b45878b69d6f7843d3268824d.png"][/img][/p][p]Orange Trees fruit during mid/late summer[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/2c3f1af8289816eb9c66799baf5ab3a39c834da3.png"][/img][/p][p]Lime Trees fruit during mid/late spring[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/0fab49285f4aec56760656e4b256d1619f0da69f.png"][/img][/p][p]Apple Trees were already added last week, they fruit during mid autumn.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/3b9ebcd2e4d3282646251e782a1cad96423ed111.png"][/img][/p][p]Keep in mind fruit trees can only fruit when fully adult, while growing they can flower, but they will not spawn any fruit, so if you see a singular fruit tree not giving fruit, it might be because it was not fully grown.[/p][p]With this we have 6 out of 13 fruit trees implemented, I will be adding the last ones in a week or two.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]Changelog[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]*V0.75.7.1 ~ 27.06.2025 ~ Unity 2020.3.46f[/p][p][/p][p][b]Features:[/b][/p][p]Removed the last placeholder trees in the town, added Wisdom Trees (Golden Apples) in their place[/p][p]Added Lime Trees[/p][p]Added Lemon Trees[/p][p]Added Orange Trees[/p][p]Added Cherry Trees[/p][p]Added a sprint is toggle option in gameplay and a hotkey (default Capslock) to toggle sprinting mode[/p][p][/p][p][b]Changes:[/b][/p][p]Added tree shake animation when hitting trees[/p][p][/p][p][b]Fixes:[/b][/p][p]Fixed strange visual bug that happened in some parts of the caverns[/p][p]Fixed tree life not reflecting it's age[/p][p]Fixed a cooking filter issue[/p][p]Fixed a empty error log window showing up each time you go back to the main menu[/p][p]Fixed some LOD and clipping errors with escaping critters[/p]

[b]Features:[/b]
Implemented Apple trees

[b]Changes:[/b]
Tree attachments now update every so often, so they will actually grow even if you sleep besides a tree for days

[b]Fixes:[/b]
Fixed a minor outline issue

notes.title: Friday Progress Report 420
notes.content: [p]Wild Apple trees will be up today.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/c32e76509e0eb95b9217b4c993523722ad029b39.png"][/img][/p][p]Apple trees are almost done, there is one more bug we need to fix before releasing.[/p][p]The new trees will spawn in old saves too, but it is more likely they will be in adult age if you start a new game. Apple trees take 3 seasons to grow (84 ingame days) and only fruit in adult stage.[/p][p]They will fruit during mid autumn, to harvest the apples use the sickle while aiming up, each apple is a singular entity that grows slowly until ripe, they will stay available for harvesting for about 2 weeks, make sure you harvest them before Autumn 21 or they will start despawning.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/8bfcf27f5548ecd9c0dfc1ac0f53bbf71b5367c3.png"][/img][/p][p]You can save time and stamina by cutting the whole tree down to harvest all apples at once... at the cost of an entire apple tree, which will take 3 seasons to regrow, you CAN do it, but I wouldn't.[/p][p][/p][p]The update should come out by the end of the day.[/p][p][/p][p]Next up we will add the Wisdom Trees, an alchemically modified version of the apple tree that only exists inside Edengrall city, they will replace the placeholder birch trees inside the town, these trees will not spawn naturally and cannot be cut down, they will fruit during Spring and will be the focus of the Wisdom festival that will happen mid spring when we finally manage to add festivals.[/p][p][/p][p]After the special wisdom trees my brother will work on the final features of the Tree Update, the axe charged special (aoe tree cutting), tree sapplings and the ability to plant them and some other details, meanwhile I will follow the 52 step proccess (kill me) to add new trees, we have 11 more trees modeled and textured ready to be implemented.[/p]

notes.title: Friday Progress Report 419
notes.content: [p]We went through the bug reports and released two new patches with the fixes, now that the game is more stable and optimized we can go back to adding content.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/6348e9c3173e0d62a254ae10d41b77d24f405cbc.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We will be adding the Apple tree next, as well as the Wisdom Trees with golden apples that grow inside Edengrall and will replace the birch trees.[/p][p][/p][p]Plenty things changed and the document we had detailing the step-by-step for adding trees will have new steps while some of the old ones were removed or replaced, once we have the whole proccess fully mapped I will be adding all the 12 fruit trees little by little in small updates.[/p][p][/p][p]After the fruit trees we will add the Lumberaxe special, the ability to collect and plant tree sapplings and a few more small details to finally finish the Tree Update.[/p][p][/p][p]Unless something goes really wrong the Apple Tree will be up by next Friday.[/p]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
Fixed a bug where cooking was not spending items
Fixed yet another situation where you could dig towards the world origin
Fixed cooking ingredient seeking filters ignoring the last filter
Fixed item search ignoring custom item names (like cooked dishes)
Fixed copy/paste/prefab of flipped pieces not properly placing them

[b]Changes:[/b]
Implemented the Bamboo Forest fog
Peeba has been added to daisy fields as a rare spawn

[b]Fixes:[/b]
Improved the bend calculation for stone paths and stopped it from bending on extreme cases. Only affects newly placed objects
Fixed a Z-fighting issue with a wall and floor by adding a inperceptibly small offset to the wall. Only affects newly placed objects
Added another failsafe for an array out of bounds exception
Fixed a weird issue that made some plants unharvestable
Fixed critters detection outlines not drawing correctly.
Fixed a bug when using up all of an ingredient in cooking, and saving before finishing cooking would cause the utensil to break after loading.

notes.title: Friday Progress Report 418
notes.content: [p]A little detour in development that was supposed to take 3 days took 10 instead, we are sorry for delaying the fruit trees for this, but what is done is done.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/0a140bbc53f2ab06e6cf401c70eb6bb8e77265f5.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The bamboo forest now has a dense fog that finally gives the spooky feel it was meant to have. The fog took extra time for two main reasons, my brother integrated the depth culling in the fog, so anything obscured by the fog will be culled (for performance) and the fog generation happens automatically in the bamboo forest biome, so we won't need to manually place it in the map.[/p][p][/p][p]There are a few bugs to fix still, we will release a new version with the fog and bugfixes before going back to finishing the Fruit Trees, after finishing the tree update we will work on the new crop perks.[/p]

notes.title: Friday Progress Report 417
notes.content:
We are adding fog to the bamboo forest, our initial vision for it was to be the mysterious and spooky area of the map where people appear (will be related to the Isekai start for custom characters) and disappear, right now it is just atmosphere, there won't be anything spooky spawning inside (yet).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/0dd902eaae8fba52287fe373088a87935eeaf467.png[/img]

As soon as my brother is done integrating the fog properly we will go back to the fruit trees, we did reduce the workload to implement new trees slightly while doing the optimizations last week, so it should take a little less time to add them.

notes.title: Friday Progress Report 416
notes.content:
This little detour to optimize the game a bit sure took some time, but at least we got pretty decent results, the only thing we didn't manage to optimize was the tree leafy shader which will take more extra effort and maybe two more weeks, so we have decided to finish up the current optimizations and bugfix to release a new build.

There are one or two bugs (that we identified) left, so the update will be up soon, probably on the sunday if there aren't more bugs.

Now that the game runs better we started to think of other problems to solve, one of the worst being the current crop system and the mess of seedstacks you have to manage to do crop selection, so we have decided on a more radical solution, after we finish the tree update, we will delay the survival mechanics to bring in a crop perk overhaul.

Crop perks will no longer be random, there will no longer be negative perks and the maximum amount of seed stacks for each crop in your inventory will be 6 (zero star seeds, and 1 to 5 star seeds).

We will do it by making each crop a skill, leveling up this skill by harvesting the crop will grant perk points at fixed intervals, and you will be able to spend these perk points choosing the perks you want, making a build for each crop.

The perks will no longer be saved on the seeds, but on your character instead (there will be a new UI for that) and the seeds will only carry the potential to unlock the choosen perks based on their tier, for example, a 3 star Turnip seed will have access to up to tier 3 perks, even if you have maxed the Turnip skill and have choosen 5 star perks in the UI, the Turnips you plant will still require a 5 star seed to access these high level perks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/cac56e1fa0e17f6c7626eb321734b22ac4debc98.png[/img]

Crops will have exclusive and generic perks, the generic perks are often slightly weaker, but they are flexible, once learned they be can placed into other crops, so you could take a Turnip generic perk and apply it to a Potato, giving a big incentive to the player to try different crops,

This will also open the window to unique perks that can be unlocked in different ways like exploration or by winning festival competitions in the future.

notes.title: Friday Progress Report 411
notes.content:
The game is still lacking depth, and adding more land won't help with that, so we are delaying the Exploration update to add more depth to the gameplay and finish some half-done features.

Custom Difficulty:
A third difficulty option where you can pick and choose what gets enabled and disabled.
This would let us bring some features we disabled for now as the player has little options to deal with them like food spoilage and temperature.

Survival Features:
Hunger, Drowning, Wounds and other ways to get a game over in Survival mode to give it more consequence, getting a game over would bring up the same screen you get if you fail to pay the debt, but instead of being thrown in sandbox, you can just go into a custom difficulty and disable only a few Survival mechanics.

Town Favour, Respect and NPC Favors: 
Respect is a second relationship bar, the first being Friendship, respect is earned by doing certain actions the NPC approves, for example Mint likes when you become a good woodworker, Reiko likes when you pay your debts and help other citizens and Sasha likes when you gain Friendship with other citizens.
Town Favor is a resource, earned by completing NPC quests, trading with NPCs, and doing any action that would earn respect with an NPC, you can use this resource to buy:
NPC Favors, these are special actions an NPC can do for you, spending Town Favor, some examples of Favors are Marie giving you a stamina injection for instant stamina recovery once a day, or Reiko cooking something special for you, Favors are unlocked at different respect thresholds.

Events and Festivals:
We want to make at least 2 or 3 kinds of festivals to give the town more life, something like a cooking or fishing competition, we need to change a few things on the NPC AI to make it happen.

Weather: 
Rainy days at least, we might leave storms for later, this could also come with an overhaul to the skybox to make it more stylized matching the artstyle better. Working during rainy days will cost extra stamina.

Fairy Village: 
The biggest feature in this list, this will bring more fairies, fairy breeding, automation and more integration with other features like crops, cooking and critter catching as well as the other 5 movement spells.

This is the bulk of what we want to implement before expanding the map, it will probably take the rest of the year to do it all, so exploration is now a 2026 feature.

On this week progress, there wasn't much, we are getting the tree forageables done, it is taking time, we managed to get some multithreading working, so the game will use different CPU cores to search for nearby trees and apply their forageables (mushrooms and such), and we might just use this same system to make the fruits, so maybe we won't need to implement even more systems to finally finish this feature.

notes.title: Friday Progress Report 401
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/ff1395920631da631a870725cfc73c5c2624c35d.png[/img]

Our trees are coming along, here what we have done so far:

Growth: Like all our crops, the trees begin as tiny saplings and grow slowly to adult size, right now they grow pretty fast (14 days) because we want players to have access to wood, we will slow down the growth based on species when we expand the map.

Seasons: Leaves change colors based on seasons, they also fall during winter exposing the low poly branches.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/c01462ba081a8d041bc79b5f4949f66d76e2e6e6.png[/img]

Cutting: The trees can be cut for wood, the stump has to be dug with a shovel. (need to add particles and sounds)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/ce76ea283f123118b089fab8a31edcd5ea0d9104.gif[/img]

Wind: Trees are affected by the wind, both leaves and branches move. (need to add leaf particles on strong wings)

What needs to be implemented:

Flower and Fruit cycles: once a year trees that can give fruit will go through flowering and fruit cycles if they are adult.

Hosting critters: We want to make tree trunks spawn points for certain critters.

Tree seeds: Trees will first behave like a crop, you have to plant them in a crop tile and their nutrition/water needs will be very demanding, after reaching the sapling stage they stop growing as a crop, the player has to dig them up and replant in normal soil.

Collision: The trees are not GameObjects for optimization reasons, so we need to add a collision mesh that follows the plant shape, will probably involve lots of capsules.

Level of Detail: We are going to experiment with the Impostor LOD system, but I might just make simplified models for the trees, we have to see what is the most optimal.


If everything goes well the update will be out by the end of the month.

notes.title: Friday Progress Report 390
notes.content:
We are finishing our commissions, soon we will be back to working on Edengrall fulltime, and the money we saved should keep us working on it for a few months even if the sales remain weak. In the worst case we will find another commission mid 2025 and work part time again, whatever happens we are not giving up.

There will be very little progress during december, but after we finish our side jobs we will resume work on 2 main things:
-Removal of placeholders
-Preparing for exploration update

We want to finally get rid of the placeholder gathering locations (the mine and the wooden cart near the town's entrance) by adding proper mining nodes and cuttable trees, the work on mining nodes is halfway done, the Pickaxe is mostly implemented, but we still need some more work to get it in the game.

The exploration update need 3 main things:
-Adaptation of the grass system to allow dynamic load and unload (this will take a long time by itself)
-Proper LOD models for all plants using the imposter system (halfway implemented)
-Dynamic loading and unloading of terrain (might also take a while)

The expansion of the map will probably impact the performance, so in the worst case we will also need to optimize the game further, and squeezing more FPS out of the game is getting harder and harder.

After the exploration update we will also unlock the temperature and food spoiling mechanics, there will be a few special containers to keep food from spoiling, but the greenhouse mechanic will probably take a while to implement.

We expect to finish these by mid 2025, after that we want to finish the Fairy Colony and the special movement options they unlock.

notes.title: Friday Progress Report 386
notes.content:
We have added a new skill and tool, you can now find Mysterious Mounds on any sand or dirt terrain (no caves), each biome has a different loot table. Mounds only respawn every 28 days, so you can only dig them up once per season.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/c1de324ef26d41bb931fec9dc8095090503f5388.png[/img]

Mounds in the beach are very easy to spot, and on the Bamboo Forest are also quite easy since the grass is lower there, but on grassland they are well hidden, so to find them the main way is to use the Shovel alt-fire, it activates your treasure sense in a pulse that highlights hidden treasure. But your Fairy can also spot and highlight the mounds for you.

If you are loading an old save the Shovel will appear in your inventory, and the mounds might take a few ingame hours to spawn.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/0b76b2de1b2e66f38051acfb9405507e701d9d6f.png[/img]

Each Mound has a random amount of treasure, the more treasure the bigger is the chance an Artifact will be found, artifacts can only be found once per year, so if you want a duplicate to decorate your house you have to wait until your second year.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/2f84d4c9310dec81e3cbd7bd8cb9579bdf39e18e.png[/img]

After talking to Frederick once you can access the pedestals in the museum and place Artifacts there for a debt reduction if playing on survival mode, there are two tiers of Artifact:

Common artifacts are Pottery and Bronze Medals, these grant 1% debt reduction.
Rare artifacts are Fossils and Brass Medals, these grant 2% debt reduction.

This reduction does stack with the critter and fish bonuses. In the future decorating the museum will also improve your standing with the citizens of Edengrall.

notes.title: Friday Progress Report 380
notes.content:
We are almost done with the first part of the museum update: the aquariums and terrariums.
To unlock them you will need to talk to Frederick, in exchange of bringing unique species for him to study he will ask Reiko to lower your weekly debt (if playing on surivival mode).

Each fish/critter placed will lower the debt by 1%, 2% if it is shimmering, but it only counts different species. The reduction stacks multiplicatively, so if you could get 100 fish/critters for 1% reduction each the total reduction would be 63.4% (1-(0.99^100)) instead of 100%.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/58b6c47dd4297ba3265371676f6723e3d0f3cee0.png[/img]

notes.title: Friday Progress Report 374
notes.content:
We found a problem with how the cooking taste and nutrient caps were applied causing issues if players stacked high value ingredients with effects that boosted the values above 100, the problem has been fixed and you can now work with high taste and nutrient values and the 100 cap will only apply on the final result.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/500ce8cb1fd31b5ee6189206c4d5ccfae1d62b90.png[/img]

This required adding a new tag on every single ingredient, it should update correctly on existing saves, but just to be safe start a new game if you enjoy minmaxing the cooking.

We also had time to add a new edible forage, Witchhat Catcaps will spawn during winter, harvest them before the cat ears pop as the spores are toxic and you cannot eat the mushroom flesh after the spores form.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/1988e919e4a179e7e130f9a38ad64c568768617b.png[/img]

With this we have reached 40 wild forageables, 45 fish and 80 critters spread through the seasons and biomes, this is a lot of content most players don't notice at first, the game also doesn't really give any tips, so we will work on it, NPCs will give you tips and trivia on the nature bounty of Edengrall, and after getting the tips your collections screen will show where and when to get the critter or fish with more detail.

notes.title: Friday Progress Report 369
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/b17057bfba09277fe0c117565ae7ad7ed5d1bcce.png[/img]

Right now the Fairy has 3 behaviors that the player can punish or reward.
-When a shimemring critter is spotted, the Fairy will notify you.
-When a critter you don't have yet is spotted she can stop to look at it.
-When you trigger a fluff of Poofahs she will get distracted and play with the Poofah.

Headpatting the Fairy after these will increase their frequency and lower cooldowns, cheek pinching does the opposite.

Now that the system is working we will expand it by adding all the planned behaviors, most of them are helpful, but there will be a few naughty ones like Frog poking and Poofah bullying.

After we finish implementing all the animations we will take a tiny break from the Fairies to add a QoL feature, NPCs will be able to give you tips on critters and fish they request, the collections screen will show spawn location and time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/e88f6325dfb7fd1e690ce2a330dcd78608b1ace3.png[/img]

Then we will return to the Fairies, we will add Fairy furniture, a bed, toolshed and a treats table with the ability for the player to set up food in the table for the Fairy to eat, for this reason I am working on 3d models for many of the recipe types, the player will also be able to just set these up in tables as decoration.

notes.title: Friday Progress Report 360
notes.content:
The first part of the Fairy Update is here, this update marks the beginning of our most game changing update yet, this first release took long to make because we had to build several new systems, and now that we have this base done the next updates will come a lot faster.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/dfdd9037e3913527ffd16edde77ca7bf18c9fc34.gif[/img]

This update will let you get your first Fairy, you can get her by speaking to Tiana, this doesn't require a new game, talking to her in a old save should still start the curscene to get the fairy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/ba266b98c9e23f29be1637de5922b9acf3498e52.png[/img]

Reminder that you can click Tiana's icon in the map to get a guide line to her.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/877aa8e86be8940a4cb513072c70d9677fef2888.gif[/img]

Upon speaking to her the cutscene starts, you will get a short explanation of Tiana's situation and will be able to customize the Fairy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/adfb05a1e23ff2a653d6d7623212f54ec4a00bef.gif[/img]

As soon as you get the Fairy she will grant you the spell Rockstep, 3 floating rocks will surround you indicating how many aerial jumps you can make, they regenerate upon touching ground. Using this does not cost any Stamina, so jump around to your heart's content.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/4c27b16756eb61705b99411dd5e2912e7f5202fd.gif[/img]

In the future you will be able to choose between the 6 movement spells instead of only getting rockstep.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/9c335bbef9373ad55f31bbe4784707e6c47714c5.gif[/img]

And if you think multi jumps are fun, check out the other new movement option: Wall running!
This is core movement option and does not involve magic, so you get it automatically even without a fairy. Wall running synergizes with Rockstep as it allows you to regain jump charges while touching the wall, with enough skill you can use this combination to climb walls.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/4ba2de993efd61508470ddcdacf9df6ffe17aad7.gif[/img]

Right now the fairy doesn't do much other than looking pretty, we didn't manage to add all the actions and behaviors we wanted because of all the bugfixing we had to do to get this update out today, but we will keep adding new Fairy animations, emotes and behaviors in smaller patches starting out tomorrow.

As soon as we finish implementing all the Fairy animations and interactions we will start work on the part 2 of the update, unlocking Fairy 2 and 3 as well as the other 5 movement abilities, the Fairy UI and the ability to raise the fairies affection as well as feed them.

We have been working on the intro cutscene for the Fairy. You will be able to get her as soon as you start the game, all you have to do is to locate Tiana and speak to her once. This will start the Fairy get cutscene, our first NPC event.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/9c307c4d0cd55ee5c75850a919ca0762d3bd8065.png[/img]

Tiana will notice you have the correct mana affinity to resonate with Fairies, something she lost as she became human-sized, so she decides to [strike]push her responsibilities on you[/strike] grant you this wonderful opportunity!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/21732b34f88f9f5def252f1acd07a84c52fb950f.png[/img]

She will lead you to where one of the Fairies went, behind the large tree, the cutomization menu pops up and you will be able to customize the Fairy appearance and name her.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/16585ffdc09558a6957d685e1fdafdbcbd888d83.png[/img]
(This screen is still a work in progress)

The fairy will grant you Rockstep magic and you will now have access to 3 aerial jumps, later when we have more Fairies you will be able to choose the Fairy elements so she grants you different movement magic, right now its Rockstep only.

At this first release the fairy will have very simple actions, like pointing at critters you haven't seen before to help you fill your collection, capture small critters on command, and a few clumsy actions like hitting her face on the wall when flying too fast.

Behaviors will be complex sets of actions with different conditions and animations with more significant world and player interactions, a Behavior can be helping the player irrigate crops, poke a frog until it gets angry and tries to eat the fairy, play with poofahs like they were volleyballs, etc... The main difference between Actions and Behaviors is that you will be able to either punish the fairy with cheek pinching or reward her with headpats to change the frequency of the last behavior, so spoiling your fairy with only headpats might lead to a more mischevous little bastard.

During the following weeks we will adding lots of actions and behaviors to the Fairy in small weekly updates, once your first Fairie has all the behaviors we have planned we will start working on the systems required for multiple fairies.

notes.title: Friday Progress Report 352
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/c8ba41976ac5f63a6ccdce4cccac6e1881fe1b14.png[/img]

As mentioned last week, Faeries will be connected to movement magic. In Edengrall there are 6 basic elements, faeries can have affinity for any element and each element is linked to a different movement spell:

Water - Waterwalk
Fire - Blastdash
Earth - Rockstep
Air - Airglide
Light - Blink
Dark - Moonjump

This week we began implementing Waterwalking, each movement spell will have 3 levels of intensity, you can upgrade the movement spell by having a faerie with very high elemental affinity or many faeries with weak affinity, more details on this later when we implement the Faerie UI.

Lv1 Waterwalk: Allows to move on water, the spell loses power as you move, so staying still lets you float forever, allowing the player to fish on high seas, jumping or sprinting will break the spell.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/8884ea4633d8d8dc407370580a9dbe2eab2ee51d.gif[/img]

lv2 Waterwalk: The spell now remains active when you jump, and you can jump when underwater to get boosted out of the water, you also get access to waterskating (water sprint)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/9b0f9c71d0b33f607ea3dc5adc184c33cd2b81ff.gif[/img]

lv3 Waterwalk: You now have turbo waterskating, you can move extremely fast on the water surface, this will be one of the most effective ways to travel long distances and will turn rivers into roads.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/453f4e91ceb991deebb04f1bfe25df6a7490dfc3.gif[/img]

This is still work in progress, we need to add more particles, sounds and fine tune everything as well as maing the UI elements for buff indicators and the bar that measures the duration.

On the Faerie model I have finished converting the hair into pieces that can be assembled into different styles

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/cc4be1c8393b976c07b6ef30de353debd8691203.png[/img]

Then I will move to the new face rig.

notes.title: Friday Progress Report 351
notes.content:
We have decided to add the faeries before we continue the exploration, but this is not the old system we had planned, but a whole new one inspired by Palworld.

This is the idea for the old Faerie System, very UI heavy and simulated, this screenshot is from the Everyday Lite prototype that I made before Edengrall.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/c48d8aee17289f26410ac4a7d8ceff751e77ea27.jpg[/img]

The new system will be fully integrated into the world, less UI and more Faeries moving around, working, emoting, playing pranks and such.
The new Faeries will help you around the farm and lend you their magic for more movement options.

You will be able to keep a few Faeries with you, these are your Companion Faeries. They will give you more options for movement based on their element:
Fire: Blastdash -> quick acceleration, can be used while airborne
Water: Waterwalk -> walk/run on water, useful for fishing in deep sea
Air: Glide -> converts horizontal into vertical momentum
Earth: Rockstep -> Spawns a platform under your feet allowing double jumps
Light: Blink -> Teleports to the direction you are looking at, kills momentum
Dark: Moonjump -> Lower gravity for a few seconds, combos well with Blastdash and Rockstep

Other than lending you movement magic, you will be able to keep one companion faerie active, the faerie will follow you around, you will be able to headpat, give treats and give orders.
When combat is added the Faeries will also lend you combat magic.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/0194b28ab7da3a639a06a4b638c36b63cf85586a.png[/img]

Each faerie will have different jobs and affinities based on their traits.

Faeries not assigned to be companions will remain at the nearest fae tree (the large tree at the top of the cliff near the town) or at player made faerie houses.
You will be able to build beds, tiny houses, amenities and work stations for them.

At first we will only add one Faerie to test the system as companion, this may take a few weeks before it is playable.

notes.title: Friday Progress Report 349
notes.content:
Frederick has been added to the game, he is one of the original founders of Edengrall, but only took a minor part in the town's creation and did not join the founder expedition which led to their disappearance because he has health issues.

He dedicates his life to his research and is quite hard to befriend, but he offers good rewards for quests.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/b18c75c5c0cf1aa344b12e86f5653ff3bdca3174.png[/img]

While adding him to the game we were checking which parts of the process are easily moddable and how much work would be needed to add a new character.

Unfortunately everything related to the NPC living quarters, and their responsibilities is hard to mod because it requires modifying the main scene, adding furniture, changing the objects that determine zones and jobs.

So about 85% of the process is easily moddable, but there is a final part that would require messing with the main scene and would cause compatibility issues when modding, we will need to overhaul this eventually when we have some more time.

We are working right now on changing how the game records time to fix a bug that happens in very long games (after winter) and we are adding the ability to choose the starting day and the randomseeds that generate forage and critters.

notes.title: Friday Progress Report 345
notes.content:
The update should be up tomorrow, there is one last feature we need to finish.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/da01ea927015679f75e2cc29076521f2e0a801bf.png[/img]

Now a wild version of every crop will be able to spawn randomly, each has a specific biome and time period for spawning and only do so once per year.
Wild crops have a significant stamina cost to harvest and have a much lower yield than cultivated ones, they also have lesser quality, the quality penalty can be negated by leveling the Forage skill.
Seeds from these wild crops always have the "Wild Plant" negative trait and the quality of other traits is based off your Forage skill.

This will add a lot of variety and color to the world as well as a new activity in Foraging, which was already possible with the new forage-only plants we added previously, but now you can expect to always have something different to harvest in the wild.

We are also making King-sized fish (these are fish with maximum size for their species) a lot more common, so you will be able to enjoy harder fights and have an easier time filling your fish collection.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/fc38ebe3d45853514ea990813929241e95b28e83.png[/img]

There are a bunch of other smaller changes like Catarina shops no longer closes during noon to 2 PM and carps now jump, but these you will be seeing in the patch notes as soon as the update drops.

We will keep trying to make smaller patches like this for the following months, releasing something every 1 or 2 weeks, in the plans for following updates are Starvation, being able to choose your starting day and Mining rocks with the Mining pick as a new tool.

notes.title: Friday Progress Report 344
notes.content:
This week we have been busy bugfixing, but we also managed to finish the base of the survival mode, the update will be dropping today after a few more small bugfixes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/aa1dfe04f1c61c61d5ccf9b7f41a95718f04b119.png[/img]

Survival mode has no freebies (you start with only tools and 100g), no tutorial and an infinite debt that increases exponentially every week, but in exchange you get a score at the end of your run based on your performance.

If you fail to pay the debt the run ends, you get scored and can continue playing in Sandbox, you can no longer increase your score unless you load an older save from before the gameover or start a new playthrough.

For those who like the relaxing no-pressure gameplay we had before it is still available in Sandbox mode, nothing changed there, except you now begin with some extra building materials so you can make a small house from the very start.

Next week we will be finishing up the Forage system by adding a wild version of crops to the system, so you will be able to see wild turnips and carrots growing randomly.

notes.title: Friday Progress Report 343
notes.content:
The survival mode is now on the beta branch, but is still being tested and it is very unbalanced, we will spend this week fixing it up and it should release in the main build by next Friday.

The current state of the game is now called Sandbox, and not only will still be accessible, but you will also start with more stuff now in Sandbox mode(enough building materials to make the sample workshop house). Survival mode starts with tools only and 100g, so spend them wisely.

If you want to jump on the beta in a day or two (after we do a bit of a rebalance) and give us some feedback it would be very helpful.

Right now in the survival mode the money will be automatically discounted from your pocket by the end of the week, in the future there will be an option to pay Reiko directly. There will also be debt discounts based on the resource we have half-implemented called "Favor", you will earn favor by watering NPC crops, doing quests for them and buying stuff from them.

If you fail to pay the weekly debt you will get a score based on your performance and will be put in Sandbox mode, so you can keep playing. To improve your score you will need to restart the playthrough.

notes.title: Friday Progress Report 342
notes.content:
One of the major complaints about the game is the lack of direction/objective, so we have decided to spicy up the game a bit with a Survival mode.

The current game will still be available as Sandbox mode, All limitations and challenges will only exist in Survival mode and in the future also available on a Custom mode where you choose every aspect of the playthrough.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/dfa088044ef0007857b1b5b0d22c65075f8b0d83.png[/img]

The Survival mode main feature will be the crippling infinite debt, the game will finally be relatable to americans who went through college! The debt must be paid every week and at first release it will be the only game over condition (until we implement death by hunger, sickness or damage). The amount required to pay increases every week until the player cannot pay it anymore.
The game will give you a score based on how much you managed to pay and how much you did in the game up to the point where you lost.

We also want to add roguelite mechanics where you earn metacurrency based on your score to make the game slightly easier on the next run, but this won't be available on this first release.

We expect this update to be ready by January 7th, as we are trying to rush smaller updates with higher frequency instead of 5 month long ones like this last one.

notes.title: Friday Progress Report 341
notes.content:
Graphical (and Forage) Update is here!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/013a7a4464bb7838137ed1a09d8069e91c8711f0.png[/img]

This update has been in the works for quite a while, but are finally ready to deliver!

For Demo users: Playing as a custom character is no longer available in the free demo.

Warning: This update requires a new game, old saves will not work.


Graphical Overhaul

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/5ca42cabc106b2c2f8cd4daf5e9e670777dca352.png[/img]

The aim of this update was to make the game artsyle more consistent, and we have replaced many shaders, textures and materials to do so.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/98137d3ce2302ec1a04f461560b9e5097b8345d0.png[/img]

Edengrall City has been completely remade, every single building was touched, we have improved the meshes, made new textures and materials, the shading has been changed to match the characters and give the game a more consistent artstyle.

Water shading was also changed to match, we have decided to make it more opaque and it looks a lot better.

The grass now changes color with the seasons (the trees and bushes still do not, we will replace them later).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/3957eee21f6f15e3474805aca4217b518027f127.png[/img]

Forage System

The placeholder blueberry bushes have been removed, blueberries have a proper model and are now a crop.

As a replacement we have added many new wild plants.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/8dde98584da4a052cf5cac3552845f492d23b568.png[/img]
Bamboo: The bamboo now grows and can be harvested, it begins as a shoot that only spawns during spring, if harvested in this stage it is edible, if left to grow it becomes an adult bamboo plant, for now the adult bamboo drops softwood as a placeholder, in the future we will add bamboo sticks and building parts that use it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/bd12a625dcdbd125ed635994745c9ca0007e7cac.png[/img]
Dandelion: A small flowering weed that grows during spring and summer, almost every part of the plant is edible, you can find them growing in the borders of grassland biome.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/ae1cfe87dc98fa64b42c719c3444515598d5aa30.png[/img]
Violet: Another flowering weed, similar to dandelion and shares the same biome, but grows on summer and autumn.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/b4f83eef798c402c11f4f7d79606840765e19ae9.png[/img]
Nasturtium: An edible bush that grows in clusters, they grow on mid spring and flower during summer, the entire plant is edible, from leaves to flower buds, the flowers and the seed pods.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/7f56643ef97816f6da13e9dcd6a555da55abeab1.png[/img]
Cattails: A reed that grows on riverbanks, the roots are edible and can be harvested all year around, cutting the plant while it has seedpods will explode the pods into a satisfying amount of particles. These plants hold a secret.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/39e6f5d3b012421e4920beb7772797bbec55981c.png[/img]
Edenian Mushrooms: Edible mushrooms that grow on grasslands and forests.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/d6942eb3f8651ab1310c41f159d27401e56a3bfa.png[/img]
Cave Stools: A slightly poisonous mushroom found in caves, can be eaten if cooked properly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/165fc75a1d753f2d543b3f68313392967203e532.png[/img]
Glowcaps: The only non-edible forageable, can be sold as an alchemical ingredient or used as bait.

More plants will be added in future updates, including wild versions of crops.


New Fish

10 new fish have been added, most of them are rare in the current version of the game as they are intended to be spawning in the reef to the east which will be the first area we will unlock in future updates.


New Furniture

4 new Furniture pieces with models made by Grispinne, they are fancier than the usual furniture and require Hardwood.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/8ae97048a9034b17a73e8bf5e0e782656d2552e2.png[/img]


This update took way longer than expected, it had a lot of engine work, at least it built a good base for future exploration features.

For our next update (January) we are going to work on splitting the game into two modes, Sandbox and Survival.

Sandbox: The current state of the game, you cannot die, no time limit, food doesn't spoil and season doesn't affect crops.

Survival: You have a debt to pay every week, and the quota increases exponentially, failing to do so will present the player with a choice, either delete the save and restart or switch the current game into Sandbox mode, at the end of your run you get a score, the further you go the higher the score.

The wild crops will spawn in large patches and will replace the placeholder berry bushes, blueberries will now be a crop, wild blueberries will only give fruit during autumn.

Wild crops will drop both crops and seeds like cultivated ones do, and we want this to be the main way of getting seeds, so we are nerfing the seed drops from grass by 80%, you no longer get ANY seeds when using he scythe, only with sickle.

From current to first beta:
Rewrote the map raycaster into native containers and added spawnables graph
changed the city to the new version
added grass to the bamboo forest
From first beta to current beta:
removed unused textures from memory
map texture atlas maker code moved to GPU -> removed 10 seconds and 1.8gb ram spike
LoadDatabase 6 sec to 3.8 sec

From the current version to our current build

Loading main menu: from 23 to 13 seconds
Loading a save: from 44 to 30 seconds
GPU memory from 3.6gb to 3.3gb
RAM memory from 3.2gb to 2.4gb
CPU use reduced by about 30%, but the GPU use was increased by 15% because now the GPU is doing some work that the CPU was doing less efficiently.

We finally managed to release the beta, it contains the city overhaul (99% done) and the test version of the new forage system applied to bamboo only for now.

Bamboo plants are now destructible awarding the player softwood sticks or planks (placeholder, it will drop bamboo one day, after we make bamboo building pieces), if enough bamboo are destroyed new shoots will grow and slowly turn into adult plants, we keep track of every single bamboo and managed to do so without impacting performance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/eb57c82c8b106144c0b121abd7453dfe8f5f5b2a.png[/img]

We do still need to do some tweaks and change the way the system saves the entities, so this will cause the next version to be save-incompatible with the current beta, so if you start a playthrough now, do so knowing it will not be compatible with the main build update.

Now we are going to add other plants to the system, starting with wild edible weeds, dandelion, violet and cattails, then we will convert our crops to allow them to spawn as wild crops too, these wild crops will drop seeds like a cultivated crop does, because of this we will drastically reduce the random seeds gathered by cutting grass.

This update might look small, but a lot of engine work was required to make it all work, there are still some issues to fix and a lot of polish to make, the full update might take as much as a full month to release.

notes.title: Friday Progress Report 328
notes.content:
I began applying the new wood and stone textures and correcting even more UV errors, and now most of the town is done, I just need to make some new interior textures like walls with baseboard instead of just flat walls, I will probably finish this week, then will begin the proccess of reimporting the entire town to the main scene and testing the new collisions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/36c1886251cca0fa0dcafb521cbba6c4dc8c15e4.png[/img]

On more exciting news, the new spawn system finally spawns something! My brother is using the bamboo for testing, and the bamboos are already being remade into interactable forageables, bamboo wil always spawn as edible shoots, and will grow into adult plants over time, the adult bamboo will now be harvestable into soft wood (placeholder until we make bamboo building parts), shoots will only grow on spring, so if you harvest too much the area will be empty until next spring. Right now they are missing collision, so my brother is working on it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/fe3df1b79c9f196840a77938b1b207ed7b72a5c7.png[/img]

notes.title: Friday Progress Report 327
notes.content:
Now that I have settled on the stone wall texture I have started making variations to add details, like the castellations, the old version also had details in the castellation texture, but it was very hard to see.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/de01b3f3b94c5ab0b1e5fa706cb0b0ff2f0e4b95.png[/img]
We will also replace the old ugly trees for a more stylized and cute type from the Unity store (Dreamscape Nature: Meadows), it is more resource intensive than the old tree models, so we will only replace the tress in the playable area for now, the large forest will remain the same for now.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/fccea9b6f1ab1d514f94a52b35af97ec1d7957ea.png[/img]
We will also replace the bushes and the large fey trees.

The spawner graph now works vertically too, allowing us to spawn things inside the caves and on the cliffs, so expect the caves to be a lot less empty in the exploration release.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/c60788dc0f6f9e1b34d64412d9d92fd24d0f07e0.gif[/img]

notes.title: Friday Progress Report 326
notes.content:
I tried crafting my own textures, but they didn't look good to use on the large city walls (making good height/normal/occlusion maps is a pain), so I am trying materials from the Asset store, also instead of using a single flat texture I am mixing them up, the walls now use 3 textures splitting by the water level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/b4883dbb4004f338c2621d8d56b707d3c1081a67.png[/img]
(the castellations and the floor are still textureless in this screenshot)

I want to add a lore more detail by switching up textures through the city and make it less flat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/896bba7593a13e69b4ed7f8db4de34139c8b81b8.png[/img]

While I try out some texture combinations my brother has been finishing the forage/creature spawner graph, now all points that can spawn critters or forage will exist in a graph that will be pre-generated instead of generating/randomizing during gameplay, speeding up loading times.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/dd3315efe11d5e3df998d37e0cc796a004599433.gif[/img]

Again it has been a slow week, sorry for the lack of updates.

notes.title: Friday Progress Report 325
notes.content:
My brother has reworked the spawner distribution, so it works much better around edges and looks more natural now.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/5833ba15fc68d256a2a723a7e94c88234d498f84.png[/img]
The main reason this is taking so long is that the system is being optimized to load and unload quickly to allow for a large map on the exploration update, so the player won't have to experience frame drops while traveling when critters and folliage are spawned and despawed.

The city meshes are all done, both the visible parts and the collisions, now I am checking the UV mapping (almost all done) and then I will be making and applying new textures, now different buildings will have slightly different wall textures, so each building looks more unique.

notes.title: Friday Progress Report 324
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/72aaa0c9137cb1c562182a747d48c19000e6e415.png[/img]

My brother is still experimenting with the cluster spawning trying to make the spawns look natural, but it is having problems on biome divisions with the clusters ending abruptly in the borders.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/a1c787123bfd13308eb2d0bf9bfb2913bd1aa91c.png[/img]

The city is closer to completion, the new INN and the shop district collisions are done, and I am finishing their UV maps, after the lighthouse I will only need to do the last checks and start making new textures.

This is pretty much it for this week, sorry for the lack of new content.

notes.title: Friday Progress Report 323
notes.content:
My brother is reworking the terrain/biome system to support the new features we will need for the exploration update, specially the new spawn system, which should be a lot more precise and easy to control as it will keep track of populations and spawn them in more natural-looking clusters instead of thinly spread through the entire biome.

My rework of the town is nearing its end, the new meshes are done, the collisions are over 65% finished (the selected buildings in orange below are done)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/88808266a5fe0737cbbe00042c40a355031c2940.png[/img]

As soon as I finish all the collisions I will just need to check all UV mapping and I will be able to finally start replacing the old city models with the new ones, and then I will work on making new textures, the whole thing is probably going to take a month.

notes.title: Friday Progress Report 322
notes.content:
We are reviewing the roadmap again, here what our next updates will be about:

Exploration update: This hasn't changed much, but we are implementing something new, a new creature/forage spawn system that will track the amount of entities that have been spawned, and will spawn based on the season and the presence of other creatures, meaning the simulation of food chain populations. The exploration update also requires a review of the grass system to allow dynamic loading, so it will take at least 2 months.

City Remake update: I have been working on the city meshes for a while, and it is mostly done, But I do have to redo all UV mapping and make the new textures as well as the new collision models since many buildings changed. The new city will have plenty more gardens, lamp posts and a few buildings have been completely overhauled like the Museum.

Roguelite metaprogression and hardcore mode: This is new and will change drastically how the game works, when starting a new game the player will be able to choose either sandbox (game as it is right now) or hardcore where you start with a debt to pay weekly (amount rises every week), food will spoil, there will be death through suffocation, hunger and fall damage, failing to pay the debt or getting yourself killed will end the playthrough and award points based on your progress, these points can be spent give permanent bonuses on new hardcore playthroughs.

notes.title: Friday Progress Report 321
notes.content:
I have finished redoing the base topology of the city buildings, except for the Dracari Temple and the new structures that will dot the areas around the canal and host little gardens to add more greenery to the bland parts of the town, the Lighthouse interior was completely redone, and now it has proper red stripes as all lighthouses should.
After finishing the topology I will still have to redo all UV mapping and remake the collision models.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/939a743c186ec006625df60d3324c7a95c6b1f65.png[/img]
Meanwhile my brother has been working on the cluster spawner for our new forage & critter spawn system, we aim to create a more realistic looking distribution of fauna & flora.
In this image you can see more of less how the cluster distribution will work, the white areas are where things can spawn, the script is very configurable and the size and spread of the clusters can be changed easily, so we can have different patterns for each type of forage.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/ddc45d6ab50572835399a92e6829378c61721fd4.png[/img]

[b]Features:[/b]
Added custom expressions to characters during certain conversations.

notes.title: Friday Progress Report 320
notes.content:
NPC expressions are 99% done, we just have to finish a weird bug that doesn't happen on the Unity editor (only happens in the build), making it a nightmare to debug, there should be an update in a few days. This will be the last update before the Character Creation becomes locked in the demo version, and will be available only on the full version, so if you play on the demo version make sure to create your character now and keep the save.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/e2839e5ac1f4acce1a31072afb6c394552d92e6b.png[/img]

The Edengrall reform continues, I have added a balcony on the same floor the custom character room is, so you will be able to jump on the market roof from there.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/7f2f27661d17a77aab06116d36860a2bdcb70ff0.png[/img]

I am also adding a lot more green to the town, the roofed bridges will have hanging vines, as well as the trellis walls around the market area.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/3416e3390b7dbe6a17b0814aad1fd42caa6674fb.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/7936ac420e2248079e2555ca103c92ee28c2db70.png[/img]

These vines will add a lot more color to the town. Unfortunately the town update will still take more than a month, i still have to redo all the UV mapping.

Before that my brother will be releasing his remake of the forage&critter spawn system that will add a lot more edible forage to the world (like cattails around the river and dandelions by the cliffs)

notes.title: Friday Progress Report 319
notes.content:
We did some bug fixing after the update and started working on the next feature, NPC expressions will be added soon, each expression will be linked to a text line, so their faces will change depending on what they are saying, this will make Meru and Elly less jarring when they get scared with a poker face.
The new expressions are almost all done, I am finishing Tiana and Yui today.
My brother is working on new capsules for the game too, the current ones are not attractive at all.

This week's update is quite short sorry.

Character Creation Update is here

notes.title: Friday Progress Report 318
notes.content:
My brother is doing the final bug fixes for the custom character update and we should release today

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/a5c2e0baa77f2606d2a0112982c276027e170cd3.png[/img]

While the update is save compatible we still recommend restarting, if you load an old save you can craft the cabinet (under furnitures) to customize once, after that you can only change clothes, hair and name.

We have also fixed a few problems with the AI, NPCs' need for leisure now works, so you will see them pretend to read a book in the library now and then, also NPC crops now lose water slowly and don't show icons, so they won't die constantly from neglect and even if it happens the player won't see it unless they inspect the crops.

Character expressions will be added in the following weeks, each NPC line will now have an expression attached to it, so you will see their expressions change when talking to you.

After that we will add a lose condition to the game, you will start the game in debt and will have to be useful (either do NPC quests or pay by the end of the week), in the first 4 weeks you have to meet the quota to avoid a game over, but after that it becomes optional (you can choose to stop paying) and you will receive a score based on how many weeks you managed to pay.

It will be more than a month of work, specially now that I am job hunting.

The exploration update is officially delayed.

The gameloop now includes the NPCs, previously interactions with the citizens of Edengrall was mostly buying items from them since most people just ignored the quests, 

The new quests give you more reasons to grow crops, fish and capture critters, they also alert you to types of critters and fish you haven't seen yet and since the NPCs only ask for things that are in season, as soon as you see someone requesting a new critter you can be sure it can be found somewhere.

The next feature we will work on is the end-day screen, when midnight hits a popup (can be disabled on the options) will show your progress in the previous 24 hours, including money earned/spent, skills gained, items gathered, new collectables discovered and NPC friendship gained.

After that we finish it the work on the Exploration update begins with the first feature being the new forageable spawner that will bring Dandelions, Violets and Cattails to the world as well as the new tool, the Shovel and artifact hunting.

Then we will overhaul the grass and start expanding the terrain, starting by unlocking the zone to the east, the pillar coral reef.

notes.title: Quest Update
notes.content:
We have reworked the quest system, NPCs will no longer ask for finished food (that you cannot buy in shops), but raw resources instead, mostly fish, critters and crops.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/370898445a56a093e689676b4ce598ec65a2c5f1.png[/img]

NPCs now have lines when requesting items and when you deliver something, adding more personality to each character.

We also improved the feedback when you earn money and your current funds are shown on the UI under the calendar.

Also we removed the taste specifications of NPCs, making the ideal dish is complicated enough, having to take NPC tastes in consideration makes the system too overwhelming.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/fac7ce12ba87d74eedd3b99e55850e8675a6aa27.png[/img]
We also added this little goober (should appear by the river during summer)

notes.title: Friday Progress Report 298
notes.content:
The quests are talking a bit more than expected, the old system was a lot less flexible than we remembered, but they are almost done, As soon as we finish hunting the bugs we will release the Questing update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/797b331421d1c50bd41a1f9de2739d27fad1e9f9.png[/img]

Every NPC has their own quests, asking for critters, fish, crops and forage, in the future more items will be added to the list as we implement them.

Quests are easily moddable as they are entirely contained in XML files.

While my brother finishes up the quests I begun working on the exploration update, starting with small forage, the first plants we will be adding will be both pretty and edible.

Dandelion
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/aa182dbdef25f66487e66c3d43fa0136c037e0b0.png[/img]

A very common weed with pretty yellow flowers, did you know they are edible? The entire plant can be eaten, despite the weak nutrition and bad taste, there will be ways to prepare them and make it a decent ingredient. Dandelions will spawn in the areas between grasslands and cliffs or roads.

Violet
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36540476/7ee2e0de308094927d7f3c120df6e7c6e8d4c7b1.png[/img]

Violets are also edible and despite being cultivated in gardens IRL they are indeed weeds. They will grow in small patches in the middle of grasslands.

I am also making cattails as a new grass type, but it won't be harvestable until we add the shovel that will allow the player to gather the edible roots.

Keep in mind that these forageables will not be as abundant as they are now, most of them will take a full year to respawn, so choosing to harvest and use them all at once can lead to a nasty winter.
